name: Firecrawl
description: Firecrawl — turn any website into clean LLM-ready data: scrape a single page to markdown/html/json, crawl whole sites, map every URL, run web search, and extract structured data across pages with an LLM, via the Firecrawl v2 REST API.

methods.label: Scrape Page
methods.description: Scrape a single URL and return clean content. Body: { url (required), formats:['markdown'|'html'|'rawHtml'|'links'|'summary'|'screenshot'|{type:'json',...}], onlyMainContent (default true), includeTags[], excludeTags[], waitFor (ms), timeout (ms 1000-300000, default 60000), headers{}, actions[], mobile, parsers, location, proxy }. Returns { success, data:{ markdown, html, links, screenshot, metadata{ title, description, sourceURL, statusCode } } }. Synchronous. 1 credit (more for screenshot/json).

formats.description: Output formats, e.g. ['markdown','html','links','screenshot']; an item can be an object like { type:'json', prompt, schema }. Default ['markdown'].

onlyMainContent.description: Strip headers/nav/footers and return only main content (default true)

waitFor.description: Delay in ms before grabbing content (default 0)

actions.description: Browser actions to run before scraping, e.g. [{ type:'click', selector }, { type:'wait', milliseconds }, { type:'screenshot' }]

location.description: { country, languages[] } geo-targeting for the request

methods.label: Parse Document
methods.description: Parse a hosted document (PDF, DOCX, etc.) into markdown/other formats. Body: { url (required), formats[] }. Returns { success, data:{ markdown, metadata } }. Synchronous. 1 credit.

url.description: URL of the document to parse

methods.label: Start Crawl (Async Job)
methods.description: Start crawling a site from a base URL — follows links and scrapes every discovered page. Body: { url (required), limit (max pages, default 10000), maxDiscoveryDepth, includePaths[] (regex), excludePaths[] (regex), allowSubdomains, allowExternalLinks, crawlEntireDomain, sitemap:'skip'|'include'|'only', maxConcurrency, delay, scrapeOptions:{ formats, onlyMainContent, ... }, webhook }. ASYNC — returns { success, id, url } immediately; poll getCrawlStatus. 1 credit (the job then burns 1 credit per page scraped).

url.description: Base URL to start crawling from

maxDiscoveryDepth.description: Max link-discovery depth from the base URL

includePaths.description: URL pathname regex patterns to include

excludePaths.description: URL pathname regex patterns to exclude

crawlEntireDomain.description: Follow internal links to sibling/parent URLs, not just children

delay.description: Delay (s) between scrapes to respect rate limits

scrapeOptions.description: Per-page scrape config, e.g. { formats:['markdown'], onlyMainContent:true }

webhook.description: Webhook config for crawl event notifications

methods.label: Get Crawl Status & Data
methods.description: Poll a crawl job by id. Returns { success, status:'scraping'|'completed'|'failed'|'cancelled', total, completed, creditsUsed, expiresAt, next (URL for next page of data if >10MB), data:[{ markdown, html, links, metadata }] }. Loop until status='completed'; follow `next` to page large result sets. Free.

id.description: Crawl job id returned by startCrawl

methods.label: Cancel Crawl
methods.description: Cancel a running crawl job by id. Returns { status:'cancelled' }. Free.

methods.label: Get Crawl Errors
methods.description: List errors encountered during a crawl job. Returns { errors:[{ id, timestamp, url, error }], robotsBlocked:[] }. Use to debug pages that failed or were robots-blocked. Free.

methods.label: Crawl Params Preview
methods.description: Preview/expand the effective crawl parameters Firecrawl would use for a URL + natural-language prompt, without starting a crawl. Body: { url, prompt }. Returns the resolved crawl options. Free.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of what to crawl

methods.label: Map Site URLs
methods.description: Return a fast, complete list of URLs on a site (cheap alternative to crawling when you only need links). Body: { url (required), search (order/filter by relevance, e.g. 'blog'), sitemap:'skip'|'include'|'only', includeSubdomains (default true), ignoreQueryParameters (default true), limit (max 100000, default 5000), timeout, location }. Returns { success, links:[{ url, title, description }] }. Synchronous. 1 credit.

url.description: Base URL of the site to map

search.description: Order/filter results by relevance to this term, e.g. 'pricing'

ignoreQueryParameters.description: Drop URLs that differ only by query params (default true)

methods.label: Web Search
methods.description: Search the web and optionally scrape the result pages. Body: { query (required, max 500 chars), limit (per source, default 10, max 100), sources:['web'|'images'|'news'], categories:['github'|'research'|'pdf'], includeDomains[], excludeDomains[], location (e.g. 'Germany'), country (ISO, default 'US'), tbs (e.g. 'qdr:w'), timeout (default 60000), scrapeOptions:{ formats, ... } (set to also scrape each result) }. Returns { success, data:{ web:[{ url, title, description, markdown? }], images:[], news:[] }, creditsUsed }. 1 credit (more when scrapeOptions is set — scrapes each result).

scrapeOptions.description: If set, scrape each result, e.g. { formats:['markdown'] }

methods.label: Start Extract (Async LLM)
methods.description: Start an LLM structured-extraction job across one or more URLs. Body: { urls[] (glob patterns allowed), prompt, schema (JSON Schema for the output shape), enableWebSearch (default false), ignoreSitemap, includeSubdomains (default true), showSources, scrapeOptions, ignoreInvalidURLs (default true) }. ASYNC — returns { success, id }; poll getExtractStatus. 1 credit (extraction also consumes Extract tokens, tracked separately).

urls.description: URLs to extract from; glob patterns allowed, e.g. 'https://site.com/*'

schema.description: JSON Schema defining the structure of the extracted data

enableWebSearch.description: Allow web search for supporting data (default false)

includeSubdomains.description: Include subdomains when expanding URLs (default true)

showSources.description: Return the source URLs for each field (default false)

scrapeOptions.description: Scrape config applied to source pages

ignoreInvalidURLs.description: Skip invalid URLs instead of failing (default true)

methods.label: Get Extract Status & Data
methods.description: Poll an extract job by id. Returns { success, status:'processing'|'completed'|'failed'|'cancelled', data (the structured object/array matching your schema), sources? }. Loop until status='completed'. Free.

id.description: Extract job id returned by startExtract

methods.label: Start Batch Scrape (Async Job)
methods.description: Scrape many known URLs in one job (same scrape options applied to all). Body: { urls[] (required), formats[], onlyMainContent (default true), maxConcurrency, ignoreInvalidURLs (default true), zeroDataRetention, scrapeOptions{ headers, waitFor, timeout, actions, location, ... }, webhook }. ASYNC — returns { success, id, invalidURLs[] }; poll getBatchScrapeStatus. 1 credit (the job burns 1 credit per URL scraped).

formats.description: Output formats applied to every URL, e.g. ['markdown','html']

ignoreInvalidURLs.description: Skip invalid URLs instead of failing the request (default true)

scrapeOptions.description: Advanced per-URL scrape config (waitFor, actions, location, etc.)

webhook.description: Webhook config for batch event notifications

methods.label: Get Batch Scrape Status & Data
methods.description: Poll a batch-scrape job by id. Returns { success, status:'scraping'|'completed'|'failed', total, completed, creditsUsed, expiresAt, next (next page URL if >10MB), data:[{ markdown, html, metadata }] }. Loop until status='completed'; follow `next` to page. Free.

id.description: Batch scrape job id returned by startBatchScrape

methods.label: Cancel Batch Scrape
methods.description: Cancel a running batch-scrape job by id. Returns { status:'cancelled' }. Free.

methods.label: Get Batch Scrape Errors
methods.description: List errors from a batch-scrape job. Returns { errors:[{ id, timestamp, url, error }], robotsBlocked:[] }. Free.

methods.label: Get Credit Usage
methods.description: Get the team's remaining credits and plan info. Returns { success, data:{ remainingCredits, planCredits, billingPeriodStart, billingPeriodEnd } }. Call before large crawl/batch/extract jobs. Free.

methods.label: Get Historical Credit Usage
methods.description: Get month-by-month historical credit usage for the team. Query: byApiKey?. Returns usage broken down by billing period. Free.

byApiKey.description: Break usage down per API key

methods.label: Get Token Usage (Extract)
methods.description: Get the team's remaining Extract tokens and plan info (Extract is billed in tokens, separately from credits). Returns { success, data:{ remainingTokens, planTokens, billingPeriodStart, billingPeriodEnd } }. Call before large extract jobs. Free.
